title: Epstein as the front for a project or special access program

tellings.quote: I don't think he was running the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was.

plain: Jeffrey Epstein may have been the public face of a secret government project, or a special access programme, meaning a tightly restricted classified programme, and not the one really in charge. The mathematician Eric Weinstein speaks on the show of "the Jeffrey Epstein special access project or whatever it was" and says he does not think Epstein was running it. Weinstein names no source, and if he were right, others would have been behind what went on around Epstein.
